column2: stream EOF never terminates) leading to unbounded memory growth / hang,"In CiphertextHeaderV2.decodeInternal (src/main/java/org/cryptacular/CiphertextHeaderV2.java), the symbolic key name is read byte-by-byte from attacker-supplied header data in `while ((b = readByteFn.apply(source)) != 0)` and accumulated in a ByteArrayOutputStream.
